House design guide · 20 November 2026

The Screen Styles

Every screen look the game uses today, each with its own name and code. Pick one by name or code — e.g. “make it a P2 Mayor’s Word popup” — and it will be built in that style. Previews are drawn from the live CSS; portrait panels stand in for persona pictures.

Foundations

Shared by every style: the deck palette (Admin › Look & Style › Player screen), the Mariner’s Chart fonts, and a handful of parts that recur.

Night#15100c · page & screen base

Lacquer#2a1b14 · panels, buttons

Oxblood#7b2428 · primary, danger

Brass#c9a34e · rules, eyebrows, gold

Jade#2f6b5a · good, gains, safe

Ivory#f1e3c5 · text

Storm#385467 · sea, home port, run

Leather#6b452d · muted text mix

Crimson LedgerUncial Antiqua — titles & verdicts (“Victory!”, jail headline)
Hong Kong HarbourMedievalSharp — headers, port names, big button words
Alegreya body text, her spoken lines in italicAlegreya — reading text & figures
Port of Call · SilverSmall caps — eyebrows, plaque labels, rail labels

Cinema family

Full-screen takeovers. The deck disappears; a big scene picture fills the screen, a tall persona portrait fades in from the left edge, and huge serif captions sit centre stage.

C1

Cinema at Sea

Sea Battle action
Powder O’Rourke — full height
Powder O’Rourke
GUNNER
Enemy seat — Madam Shek
Round 3

Six pirate junks · 2 sinking

A broadside rakes her decks!

“That’s how you kiss a junk goodbye.”

Your fleet
Red LotusSea WitchJade FoxNight Heron
Fight onTrade broadsides
Run for itCrowd sail
RetreatLose some cargo, live
Used for
Every round of a sea fight, including the pirates’ bargain (gold Pay button).
Layout
Top strip (where · round pill · 10 s clock) → enemy health bar and junk icons → giant caption → your fleet (half the width, 2–3 columns) beside 3–5 big choice buttons (the other half). Gunner full height on the left, enemy commander on the right.
Look
Full-bleed battle picture, top and bottom shade, inner glow by moment: oxblood when hit, brass on a win, jade when escaping.
Source
battle.css · #seafight .sf-*

Popup family

Centred dialogs over a dark blurred backdrop. Each pairs a big persona picture with a focused message, and closes with one primary button.

Three columns: Captain portrait | settings with an icon tab row | Port Mayor portrait. Header and footer span all three.

Squarer corners (5px), strong backdrop blur, sliding toggles in jade, portrait tiles 3:4.
